other_failure_modes.description: Fitting categorical encoders (e.g. LabelEncoder) on the combined train and test sets, which leaks information about the test set categories into the training pipeline.

other_failure_modes.name: CatBoost_ShapeMismatch
other_failure_modes.description: CatBoostClassifier's predict method returns a 2D array of shape (N, 1) for multiclass tasks. Comparing this directly to a 1D array of shape (N,) causes numpy to broadcast the comparison to an (N, N) matrix, resulting in a fundamentally flawed accuracy calculation.

summary: The agent correctly formulates the task and applies appropriate models and feature engineering. However, they leak test set categorical information by fitting a LabelEncoder on combined train and test data. Additionally, a severe numpy broadcasting bug in the CatBoost evaluation drastically underestimates its accuracy, which subsequently skews the ensemble weights. The evaluation is also limited to a single split and only uses accuracy, ignoring potential class imbalance issues.
